main_line.why_en: Takes the center, opens lines for the queen and the light-squared bishop.
main_line.why_ko: 중앙을 잡고, 퀸과 밝은 칸 비숍의 길을 열어요.

main_line.why_en: Fights for d4 from the side and makes the game unbalanced from move one.
main_line.why_ko: 옆에서 d4를 다투고, 첫 수부터 판의 균형을 깨요.

main_line.why_en: Develops and prepares d4, the most common plan against the Sicilian.
main_line.why_ko: 전개하면서 d4를 준비해요. 시실리안에 가장 흔한 계획이에요.

main_line.why_en: Covers e5 and keeps the knight out of e5 and the bishop’s path open.
main_line.why_ko: e5를 막아 나이트가 못 오게 하고, 비숍 길을 열어요.

main_line.why_en: Opens the center; White gets a lead in development and more space.
main_line.why_ko: 중앙을 열어요. 백은 전개가 앞서고 공간이 넓어져요.

main_line.why_en: Trades a wing pawn for a center pawn, which gives Black two central pawns.
main_line.why_ko: 옆 폰을 중앙 폰과 바꿔, 흑에게 중앙 폰 두 개가 남아요.

main_line.why_en: Recaptures with the knight, which now sits in the middle of the board.
main_line.why_ko: 나이트로 다시 잡아요. 나이트가 판 한가운데에 서요.

main_line.why_en: Develops with an attack on e4, so White has to defend it.
main_line.why_ko: e4를 치며 전개해 백이 지키게 만들어요.

main_line.why_en: Defends e4 with a piece and develops.
main_line.why_ko: 기물로 e4를 지키면서 전개해요.

main_line.why_en: Takes b5 from White’s pieces and prepares ...e5 or ...b5 later.
main_line.why_ko: 백 기물이 b5에 못 오게 하고, 나중에 ...e5나 ...b5를 준비해요.

main_line.why_en: Develops and prepares Qd2 and f3: the English Attack.
main_line.why_ko: 전개하며 Qd2·f3를 준비해요. 잉글리시 어택이에요.

main_line.why_en: Kicks the d4 knight and takes space; d5 becomes the key square.
main_line.why_ko: d4 나이트를 쫓고 공간을 잡아요. d5가 핵심 칸이 돼요.

main_line.why_en: The knight steps back to b3, out of the way.
main_line.why_ko: 나이트가 비켜 b3로 물러나요.

main_line.why_en: Covers d5 with the bishop.
main_line.why_ko: 비숍으로 d5를 막아요.

main_line.why_en: Stops ...Ng4 and prepares g4.
main_line.why_ko: ...Ng4를 막고 g4를 준비해요.

main_line.why_en: Develops and prepares to castle.
main_line.why_ko: 전개하고 캐슬링을 준비해요.

main_line.why_en: Connects and prepares to castle long.
main_line.why_ko: 기물을 잇고 반대쪽 캐슬링을 준비해요.

main_line.why_en: Castles short.
main_line.why_ko: 짧게 캐슬링해요.

main_line.why_en: Castles long: both sides will race to attack the other king.
main_line.why_ko: 길게 캐슬링해요. 서로 상대 킹을 먼저 치려는 경쟁이에요.

main_line.why_en: Develops and prepares ...b5.
main_line.why_ko: 전개하며 ...b5를 준비해요.
